Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface selected from the group consisting of a silicon chip and a microelectronic component.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the removal occurs through heating the electronic component surface. 

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a binder, and a carrier, wherein the particle to binder ratio is about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier is about 10 ml per gram of particles, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste. 

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 µm in size. 

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 µm in size. 

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 µm in size. 

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles. 

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 µm in size. 

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 µm in size. 

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 µm in size.
